claim_verdicts.description: PaginationResult contract includes page, isDone, continueCursor, splitCursor, pageStatus fields
claim_verdicts.quote: export interface PaginationResult<T> { page: T[]; isDone: boolean; continueCursor: Cursor; splitCursor?: Cursor | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null; }

claim_verdicts.description: numItems is initial target only; may differ in reactive queries
claim_verdicts.quote: numItems: number; /**  Note: This is only an initial value! If you are running this paginated query in a reactive query function, you may receive more or less items than this if items were added to or removed from the query range.*/

claim_verdicts.description: cursor:null = start; endCursor bounds (cursor,endCursor] for gapless adjacency
claim_verdicts.quote: cursor: Cursor | null; ... endCursor?: Cursor | null; ... explicitly sets the range of documents the query will return, from `cursor` to `endCursor`. It's used by reactive pagination clients to ensure there are no gaps between pages when data changes

claim_verdicts.description: paginate() returns all items in range after first call
claim_verdicts.quote: After the first invocation, `paginate` will return all items in the original query range. This ensures that all pages will remain adjacent and non-overlapping.

claim_verdicts.description: Split lifecycle: detect on splitCursor + (Recommended|Required|len > 2x); subscribe to both halves; record ongoingSplits; complete when both have results
claim_verdicts.quote: for (const [pageKey, [splitKey1, splitKey2]] of ongoingSplits) { const bothNewPagesLoaded = getResult(pageKeyToQuery.get(splitKey1)!.queryToken) !== undefined && getResult(pageKeyToQuery.get(splitKey2)!.queryToken) !== undefined; if (bothNewPagesLoaded) { this.completePaginatedQuerySplit(...); } }

claim_verdicts.description: Split completion via splice and unsubscribe: pageKeys.splice(pageIndex, 1, splitKey1, splitKey2) then originalQuery.unsubscribe()
SplitRequired = hard limit hit, page possibly incomplete; SplitRecommended = soft 3/4 rows/bytes or oversize
claim_verdicts.quote: page_status = Some(QueryPageStatus::SplitRequired); ... if page_status.is_none() && (query.is_approaching_data_limit() || page.len() > SOFT_MAX_PAGE_LEN) { page_status = Some(QueryPageStatus::SplitRecommended); }

claim_verdicts.description: Backend split construction: Reactive-only split_cursor, fingerprint-gated end_cursor validation
claim_verdicts.quote: let should_compute_split_cursor = match &pagination_options { PaginationOptions::ReactivePagination { .. } => true, ... anyhow::ensure!(Some(&end_cursor.query_fingerprint) == fingerprint.as_ref(), invalid_cursor());

claim_verdicts.description: cursor-bounded unfetched interval: split(cursor) to bound interval; middle split_cursor = intermediate[len/2]
claim_verdicts.quote: cursor_interval defines bounded range; unfetched_interval = intersection of interval with cursor_interval; intermediate_cursors.get(intermediate_cursors.len() / 2)

claim_verdicts.description: onBaseTransition fans changed tokens into one ExtendedTransition with paginatedQueries
claim_verdicts.quote: const changed = this.queriesContainingTokens(changedBaseTokens); ... paginatedQueries = changed.map((token) => ({ token, modification: { kind: "Updated" as const, result: this.localQueryResultByToken(token), }, }));

claim_verdicts.description: One external resource per page; each page update is reconciled via native_eq with one tick per writeInCollection
claim_verdicts.quote: localQueryResultByToken returns PaginatedQueryResult combining all active page results; each page managed separately; transitions fire with full reconciliation
